title: Glucomen daypump patch activation problem
symptom: When connecting a new patch, the screen rotates from vertical to horizontal, causing the app to restart the connection process. The user is unable to reconnect with the patch and must use a new one. Other users report similar issues: the app gets stuck in a loop during patch activation, or gets stuck on 'Connecting' after pairing.
cause: The issue appears to be related to an Android pairing problem, as indicated by the log showing a StartBondTask error. The exact root cause is not fully identified, but it is linked to the pairing process.
fix: The issue was reportedly resolved by commit fba804b2cb29e7ca25bad43a696bd77e1bf54fdf, but some users still experienced problems after updating. One user suggests wrapping the old pod and paired watch in aluminum foil to prevent interference with the Bluetooth connection. No definitive fix is provided for all cases.
